# A transaction that fails for one reason and an invoice that fails for
# another, with nothing in common between them.
#
# The split states a figure finer than its currency; the invoice names a tax
# table the book has not got. Neither is about an account that could not be
# made, and neither explains the other — which is what the refusal has to not
# claim when it gathers up what else the run reported.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income

	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-01 * "Fuel"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Fuel 18.191 CAD
	Assets:Bank -18.191 CAD

customer "C-TWO"
	name: "Two Failures"
	currency: CAD

	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:

		description: "Service"

	posted:
